# Cirth v0.17.0-beta.1

The first beta of a new default look. The markup you already write keeps
working, and no class or selector is renamed, but almost every page repaints:
a magenta accent on near-grey neutrals, a near-white or near-black page with
surfaces that read as levels, type set by role, quieter controls with one
focus ring, and space between elements decided by what the elements are to
each other. Try it to see what your pages look like under it, and tell us
where it fights them.

## This is a beta

Visual defaults may still change during the beta series. The point of
publishing it is to get the new defaults in front of real pages before they
are settled.

```sh
npm install @cirthcss/cirth@beta
```

`npm install @cirthcss/cirth` is unaffected and still resolves to v0.16.0.
Pin the exact version to stay on one beta:

```sh
npm install @cirthcss/cirth@0.17.0-beta.1
```

The [Upgrading](https://cirthcss.github.io/cirth/upgrading/) page has a
table for each area below, with the override that brings back the v0.16
value where one exists.

## Breaking changes

**The `playroom` preset is removed**, with no alias. `material` takes its
place as the preset that overrides broadly; it is Material Design 3's
baseline scheme, not a recolouring of `playroom`.

```html
<!-- before -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="dist/presets/playroom.min.css">

<!-- after -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="dist/presets/material.min.css">
```

**Eleven custom properties are removed**, because the roles that replaced
them work differently:

| Removed | Instead |
| --- | --- |
| `--cirth-opacity-disabled`, `--cirth-form-element-disabled-opacity` | Disabled is a state, not a transparency: `--cirth-disabled-surface` and `--cirth-disabled-color` |
| `--cirth-form-element-active-background-color` | Focus no longer changes a field's fill |
| `--cirth-form-element-active-border-color`, `--cirth-form-element-valid-active-border-color`, `--cirth-form-element-invalid-active-border-color` | An edge keeps its colour on focus; the ring, `--cirth-form-element-focus-color`, carries it |
| `--cirth-group-box-shadow-focus-with-button`, `--cirth-group-box-shadow-focus-with-input` | A group draws one outline ring round the row |
| `--cirth-letter-spacing-tight`, `--cirth-letter-spacing-snug` | `--cirth-tracking-optical`, one relation of size; `0` turns it off |
| `--cirth-typography-spacing-top` | `margin-block-start` on the heading, or `--cirth-flow-section` and `--cirth-flow-group` |

`--cirth-form-element-background-color` and `--cirth-letter-spacing` are no
longer declared by Cirth, but still apply when you set them.

**Layouts that leaned on old defaults** may need a line of CSS:

| If you | Then |
| --- | --- |
| Relied on full-width submit buttons | A submit button sizes to its label; add `width: 100%`, or place it in a `.grid` |
| Zeroed `margin-bottom` on a Cirth element to remove its space | Zero `margin-block-start` on the element after it |
| Built a flex or grid row out of Cirth blocks | Give the row `gap` and its children `margin: 0` |
| Styled a focus ring through `box-shadow` | Focus is an `outline`, held `--cirth-outline-offset` off the control |
| Laid out a checkbox or radio label with `display: flex` or `grid` | Set `padding-inline-start: 0` and `text-indent: 0` on the label |

## What looks different

**Colour.** The default accent is magenta (`#b431c1` in light, `#c638d4` in
dark), the neutrals and both canvases are near-grey at hue 132°, and
success, warning and error take new hues. A `--cirth-primary` you set is
kept, and every accent role derives from it, under increased contrast too.

**Surfaces.** The page is near white (L 0.978) or near black (L 0.165).
Code sits on a recessed level, a card on a raised one, and a dialog,
popover or dropdown on the overlay. A field paints the surface it sits on.
Overlays share one shadow, the modal included, and a card casts a faint
contact shadow.

**Type.** Headings are 600 at 28, 24, 20, 18, 16 and 14px from `h1` to
`h6`, at every viewport width; they no longer grow on wide screens. A
field's label is 14px, a legend outranks it, and column heads, captions
and help text are 13px metadata in the muted ink. A field's value never
renders under 16px.

**Controls.** The primary is always the heaviest action: `.secondary` is a
tonal wash with no border. Focus is one opaque ring 2px off every control.
A disabled control is a neutral wash with a quiet label, never a faded
accent. A pressed button moves down 1px when motion is allowed. Inline
`code` is text in the code face, without a chip.

**Corners.** Something you operate takes the control radius, now 6px;
something that holds content takes the container radius, 9px. The search
field and the search group lose their pill.

**Space.** No element carries an outer margin of its own. The second of two
siblings takes a step of a flow scale (8, 16, 32, 48 and 80px at the
default `--cirth-spacing`) chosen by their relation, and containers own the
space inside them. Stacked fields are 16px apart in a grid or out of one.

**Checkbox and radio.** The 24px box stays the target, and the mark drawn
in it is 20px. A checked radio is filled with the accent and carries a dot.

**Motion and icons.** Dialogs, popovers and dropdown lists open with a
short fade, and stay still under reduced motion. The interface icons are
compact filled shapes.

## New and changed defaults

- Surfaces: `--cirth-surface`, `--cirth-surface-recessed`,
  `--cirth-surface-raised`, `--cirth-surface-overlay`.
- Type: `--cirth-heading-font-weight`, `--cirth-title-font-weight`,
  `--cirth-display-font-size`, `--cirth-display-font-weight`,
  `--cirth-label-font-size`, `--cirth-meta-font-size`,
  `--cirth-ink-strong`, `--cirth-tracking-optical`.
- Flow: `--cirth-flow-line`, `--cirth-flow-element`, `--cirth-flow-group`,
  `--cirth-flow-section`, `--cirth-flow-chapter`.
- Controls: `--cirth-outline-offset`, `--cirth-disabled-surface`,
  `--cirth-disabled-color`, `--cirth-control-press-offset`,
  `--cirth-danger-on-surface`.
- The modal: `--cirth-modal-background-color`, `--cirth-modal-box-shadow`.
- `--cirth-border-radius` defaults to 6px, and the container radius derived
  from it to 9px.

## API

- **Two presets:** `material` and `metro`, a cobalt accent on achromatic
  neutrals with square corners, no shadows and Segoe in light weights.
- **A nav inside a `details` disclosure stacks**: block rows, the current
  entry marked on its inline-start edge, and focus rings drawn inside the
  row. A nav in any other container is unchanged.

## Fixed

- A long breadcrumb wraps instead of overflowing a narrow viewport.
- Floating panels stand off the near-black canvas as clearly as off the
  light one.
- A one-character nav link, such as a page number, is a 24px target.
- Increased contrast applies under a root `data-theme="dark"`.
- A custom accent keeps its hue under `prefers-contrast: more`.
- A focused field with `aria-invalid` keeps its validation colour.
- A modal footer has the same space above and below its buttons.
- `[aria-current]` on a file input's button compiles to a valid selector.
- An outline button's hover wash keeps the accent's hue.

## Known issues

- When Cirth is loaded inside a shadow root, `data-theme="dark"` on the
  shadow host leaves the tokens undefined. Put the attribute on an element
  inside the shadow root instead: the `.cirth` element in a scoped build.
  This also affects v0.16.0.
- The documentation site's own stylesheet is not part of the package and is
  not covered by these notes.

## Feedback

The defaults are what this beta is asking about, particularly the palette,
the type ladder and the spacing between elements, which changed most.
Please open an issue with a screenshot and the page it is on:
<https://github.com/cirthcss/cirth/issues>.
